content.summary: Business services providers play a critical role for enterprises, assisting them with everything from new hardware integrations to consulting and marketing. content.title: Knowles (KN) Margins Decline as One-Off Loss Challenges Growth Narratives
content.summary: Knowles (KN) reported a net profit margin of 6.2%, down from 7.2% a year ago, reflecting a dip in profitability. Over the last five years, annual earnings growth averaged -3.7%, and the latest twelve months included a notable one-off loss of $14.5 million. Looking forward, analysts expect earnings to accelerate at 39.8% per year, well ahead of the US market's 15.5% average. However, revenue growth is forecast at just 6.5% per year, slower than the national pace of 10%. See our full analysis...

content.title: KN Q3 Deep Dive: Design Wins and Specialty Film Expansion Drive Outlook
content.summary: Electronic components manufacturer Knowles (NYSE:KN) reported Q3 CY2025 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 7.3% year on year to $152.9 million. Guidance for next quarter’s revenue was better than expected at $156 million at the midpoint, 1.1% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.33 per share was 7.3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
